def _as_element_types(value: Any) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
    """Normalise an ``element_types``-like value to a tuple of element symbols.

    Args:
        value: Candidate element ordering (tuple / list / any iterable of
            symbols), or anything else.

    Returns:
        The ordering as a ``tuple[str, ...]``, or ``None`` when the value
        carries no usable ordering (missing, empty, a bare string, a
        non-iterable, or a sequence holding non-strings). ``None`` means
        "unknown" to callers, never "mismatched".
    """
    if value is None or isinstance(value, str | bytes):
        return None
    try:
        elements = tuple(value)
    except TypeError:  # not iterable -> nothing to compare against
        return None
    if not elements or not all(isinstance(element, str) for element in elements):
        return None
    return elements
